description: This file defines the MiniLangException class used to represent errors specific to the Mini-language in the Apache OFBiz framework. It extends the GeneralException class and provides multiple constructors for different ways of creating exception instances.

classes.name: MiniLangException
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors in the Mini-language, extending GeneralException.

methods.name: MiniLangException()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an exception without a message or nested cause.

methods.name: MiniLangException(String str)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an error message.

methods.name: MiniLangException(String str, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an error message and a nested throwable cause.

methods.name: MiniLangException(Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a nested throwable cause.
